scope: Resolve Docker x64 PR_SET_SECCOMP failure without weakening native isolation
rootCause: The pinned runtime selected apply-seccomp from emulated Node process.arch=x64, while the Docker Linux kernel architecture is arm64. The helper must install the filter using the kernel ISA.

implementation.cancellation: Recheck cancellation after asynchronous sandbox wrapping; kill a late reported workload process group when admission has already been cancelled or timed out
